value.title: Retry fixtures and active keyed launch evidence

sections.name: body
sections.value: At #329 d63dd97, F254 descriptor identity/type and O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK guards passed 25 logger cases; each of three independent guard mutants failed. F265 owns no-row classification, evidence cleanup, launch and row write under an independently owned SpawnHold. A sentinel probe held the first row, wrote active evidence, cancelled its caller and resent the same key: the resend waited, one pane/row remained, and neither evidence file was removed before or after row publication. Removing cleanup made stale exit7/log answer 502 instead of own-wait504. Existing private-daemon race passed. Nonblocking N329-R1-01: fresh-port retries should re-seed the oversized log and verify actual bind conflict. Current retries retain an already-trimmed log and accept any both-dead/no-banner startup failure as contention; a retry can therefore weaken that round’s load-bearing scenario. MagicWand: retries must restore their starting state, not merely rerun the command. Guard mutation binaries were copied under shared-build lock and run niced with process-local switches; original sources were restored byte-identically before named cleanup.
